exposure: Other psychotropic drug use during pregnancy
outcome: Neonatal admission to a ward with monitoring
cohort: 117 live-born neonates of 93 women with bipolar disorders who gave birth after a singleton pregnancy between January 2011 and March 2021
finding: In a sample of neonates all born to women with bipolar disorders using various other psychotropic drugs, exposure to lithium during pregnancy was not associated with a greater risk of neonatal admission to a ward with monitoring compared to non-exposure.
mod_finding: Women with bipolar disorders had high rates of caesarean section (29.1%).
